description:
**CVRP relatedness destroy and capacity-aware repair.** Use a symmetric matrix and hard capacity with each customer as a single request. Savings creates the first feasible incumbent.

A Shaw-style operator removes a small group using intercustomer distance as relatedness. Pass both incomplete routes and removed customer IDs to insertion. Reinsert heavier demands first, opening a singleton if required.

Evaluate complete repaired routes by original depot-to-depot distance. Strict improvement restarts from the repaired routes. This adapts relatedness-driven large-neighborhood search to CVRP with greedy insertion in place of the source's constraint-programming repair.
